decision: Choose Source Sans Pro at body 18 px and captions 15 px. Actual audit shows more distinct I/l forms than Roboto, and the open lowercase feels patient; this remains a self-assessed visual improvement, not a user comprehension study.
revision_reason: Increase captions 14 to 15 after inspection and remove appended audit from final production composition.
counterargument: Roboto is already compact and functional; increased body/caption size contributes to the improvement independently of family choice.
score_observations: Small-screen instruction remains compact with more differentiated audit characters.
Open forms and moderate bold feel patient and capable.
Task and continuation are one line; material label and numbered steps are clear.
One family gives a coherent explanation and control system.
